topics.topic: Authority model for resending draft-write after not_applied/unknown: activation-only vs requiring EffectApproval
questions: Does a draft-write operation ever require an EffectApproval, specifically when resending after `not_applied`/resolved unknown?
If a `draft-write` attempt is resolved `not_applied`, must the resend require a fresh per-effect owner approval, or can it still run only under flow activation?

quotes: a `draft-write` runs under the owner's activation of the flow instead

Sending again after `not_applied` is a new attempt
under a fresh approval, never under a standing approval (K-08).
judgement.why: One passage says draft-write authority is flow activation, while another requires a fresh per-effect approval after not_applied regardless of class.

topics.topic: Canonical identifier/reference for a NodeExecution across actions and records
questions: What exact reference identifies one NodeExecution in product actions and records (especially capture-into-trial and inspect)?

topics.topic: ManifestOperation identity criteria when selected instance facts differ but operation digest is unchanged
questions: If the operation record digest is unchanged but installation-selected instance facts (base_url/headers/class) differ, is that the same ManifestOperation value or a different one?

topics.topic: Read-only proven flow activation behavior: when FlowActivation is created and who is recorded as activated_by
questions: For a proven read-only flow version, is a FlowActivation created automatically at proof time, or only when someone calls the activate action?
When a user invokes activate for a read-only proven version, should `activated_by` be `kernel` (automatic step) or the requesting principal?

topics.topic: Whether a StandingGrant immediately clears already-waiting owner approvals at that node
questions: When an owner grants a node while runs are already waiting for owner approval at that node, do those waiting points clear and proceed under the grant immediately, or does the run still require decisions on already-requested approvals?

topics.topic: Whether an existing slot_id may be reused when authoring later contract versions
questions: Is a request that names an existing slot_id for a later contract version valid, or must any already-taken slot_id be refused?

topics.topic: Whether multiple EffectApproval records can exist for one node attempt and which one governs actions
questions: Can multiple `EffectApproval` records coexist for the same node attempt context, and if so which one is authoritative for send/decide actions?

topics.topic: Whether non-token installation configuration changes apply live or only after restart
questions: Are non-token configuration changes (manifest_location/revision, service_instances, credentials, listen address) applied live, or only after restart?
